dct_description_sm: Statistics Canada Census Data from 2016. This dataset includes all tables provided by Statistics Canada joined with the census tracts. Each topic covered by the census was exported as a separate table in this dataset. Each table contains the total, male, and female characteristics as fields for each census tract. Topics range from population, age and sex, immigration, language, family and households, income, education, and labour. For more information on definitions of terms used in the tables and other notes, refer to Statistics Canada's 2016 Census.
